cases.question: Tell me about Pdfroo
cases.judge_reason: All claims match the expected facts and are consistent with the known public project details.
cases.answer:
**Pdfroo** is Ayush's fully client-side PDF editor — open a PDF in your browser, annotate, sign, rearrange/merge pages, find & replace, compress, and download a real flattened PDF. Nothing ever leaves your device; all parsing, rendering, and writing happen locally via **pdf.js + pdf-lib**, and it works offline once loaded.

**Stack:** vanilla **JavaScript, CSS, HTML** (no build step, no backend). Responsive across phone (375 px), tablet (768 px), and desktop (1440 px+) with mouse, pen, or touch.

**Key features:**
- Thumbnail sidebar (desktop), slide-in drawer (tablet), bottom sheet (phone)
- Drag-to-reorder (SortableJS, touch-friendly long-press on mobile)
- Rotate, duplicate, delete, insert blank pages
- Merge: append pages from other PDFs (button or drop onto editor)
- Find & replace, compress
- Landing page with kangaroo mascot, light/dark theme, Indian-language section, privacy "pouch promise"
- After first successful download: a friendly kangaroo toast — *"Done! Your PDF never left your device. Go enjoy a coffee ☕"*

**Live:** https://ayush4u.github.io/pdfroo/  
**Repo:** https://github.com/ayush4u/pdfroo (MIT License)
